dedupe_keys.name: kadastrale kaart brk cadastral map of the netherlands pdok

description: The Kadastrale Kaart is the map part of the Netherlands' Key Register Kadaster (BRK), showing the position of cadastral parcels with parcel numbers, the boundaries of the state, provinces and municipalities, and the main buildings. It links terrain and registration and serves as a base map for many applications. From version 5 each boundary carries a quality label in four classes showing how accurately it is drawn. Boundaries start as provisional lines drawn by the notary when part of a parcel is sold and become definitive once a surveyor measures them. Coverage: the whole Netherlands. Access: OGC API Features with parcel, boundary, building, public space name and address range collections, a download API, WMS and WFS services through PDOK; parcel boundaries are current to the day and other content to the month. Licence: CC BY 4.0; free. Caveats: the map only indicates boundary positions and no measurements can be taken from it; ownership and rights are in the separate registration, not in the open map. Simulation uses are parcel units for building exposure, land use and adaptation studies, linked to BAG buildings. Related records: the BAG building and address register and 3D BAG.
